设计意图： Crossover preserving the drawdown-amplified cyclical pressure mechanism from parent 1, while adopting the simple moving average (SMA) for ATR smoothing from parent 2 (AMC-002) to reduce EMA's variable responsiveness and potentially improve IC through simpler, more stable averaging. Parent 2's SMA approach targets the predictive weakness of parent 1's low IC by reducing noise in the ATR change sign

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 high_low：high - low
  2. 计算 high_pc：(high - close.shift(1)).abs()
  3. 计算 low_pc：(low - close.shift(1)).abs()
  4. 计算 true_range：pd.concat([high_low, high_pc, low_pc, axis=1).max(axis=1)
  5. 计算 atr_sma：true_range.滚动窗口(90, min_periods=90).mean()
  6. 计算 atr_change：atr_sma / atr_sma.shift(20) - 1
  7. 计算 rolling_max：close.滚动窗口(40, min_periods=20).max()
  8. 计算 drawdown：(rolling_max - close) / rolling_max
  9. 计算 factor：atr_change * (1 + drawdown)
⚠ 该因子原始 IC 为负，已整体取反（×(-1)）调正方向；下列步骤展示的是原始公式的计算过程。

🐍 原始 Python 代码 (factor_delivery)

"kw">class="kw">def factor_cyclical_pressure_drawdown_sma(df): df_copy = df.copy() high_low = df_copy["high"] - df_copy["low"] high_pc = (df_copy["high"] - df_copy["close"].shift(1)).abs() low_pc = (df_copy["low"] - df_copy["close"].shift(1)).abs() true_range = pd.concat([high_low, high_pc, low_pc], axis=1).max(axis=1) atr_sma = true_range.rolling(90, min_periods=90).mean() atr_change = atr_sma / atr_sma.shift(20) - 1 rolling_max = df_copy["close"].rolling(40, min_periods=20).max() drawdown = (rolling_max - df_copy["close"]) / rolling_max factor = atr_change * (1 + drawdown) "kw">class="kw">return factor.fillna(0).rename("str">'factor_cyclical_pressure_drawdown_sma')
